name: Araragi Nazuna
source:
[i]"I'm glad you came back.
I hope you'll enjoy your summer vacation here."[/i]

Ryuusei's old homeroom teacher at Himeshima's elementary school.
She takes Ryuusei in her care when he comes back to the island and is one of the few grown-ups he can rely on.
In the classroom, she's diligent and calm. However, she's also a martial arts master, and she teaches the children self-defense during PE.
All of her former pupils still respect her greatly.

[Edited from [url=http://ginka.frontwing.jp/en/characters/?nazuna]Official English page[/url]]
